### Added

- (agent-platform) [Workspace picker in the new-session composer](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3178) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — Starting a session offers a workspace next to the agent, remembered per agent (`Last used with <agent>`). The portal first checks that you can read all of its repositories and names those you can't, with `Start without workspace`. Shown only where the installation has a workspace-manager and you have a workspace.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.14.2...v3.15.0
